official_statement_rationale: While headline CPI inflation has moderated to 4.25 per cent, it remains above our 4.00 per cent target, and core inflation at 5.02 per cent continues to exhibit stickiness. With the economy exhibiting resilience at 7.80 per cent GVA growth and a positive output gap of 0.50 per cent, the current macroeconomic environment necessitates continued vigilance. Given the prevailing global uncertainties and the need to ensure that inflation expectations remain firmly anchored, I believe it is premature to shift the policy stance. Maintaining the repo rate at 6.50 per cent and continuing with the withdrawal of accommodation is essential to ensure that the disinflationary process is durable and that we do not prematurely signal an easing of our commitment to price stability.
